title: fix(plugin-auth)!: lift the better-auth family from 1.7.3 to 1.7.12
body:
Fixes #25096

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

- **The lift, one commit (`75aaf74a1d`).** The 11 better-auth family overrides in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and the 5 exact ranges in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json` move from `1.7.3` to `1.7.12`, still exact. The selectors keep their bound at the 2.0.0 major boundary; the header's selector rule is untouched. The lockfile is regenerated by `pnpm install` (under the verify lock), never by hand.
- **`pnpm-workspace.yaml` family note** states the new target, why, and what moved with it.
- **`auth-route-ledger.ts`**: one new row, `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth2/client/rotate-keys`. `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.12 registers it, so the catch-all publishes it. It is refused `403 access_denied` because `auth-manager.ts` does not set `allowClientKeyRotation` (measured below). This is the one test the lift turned red (`auth-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`, the mounted-surface equality).
- **Two new pin files** for vendor changes plugin-auth callers now depend on, each with one ablation leg (below):
  - `session-read-failure-answer.test.ts`: a session lookup the store cannot answer is a failure, never a signed-out caller.
  - `verification-reservation-single-use.test.ts`: the ObjectQL adapter keeps the primary key better-auth forces on a single-use reservation, so a replay is refused.
- **Version attestations**: the 32 lines under `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src` that named `1.7.3` were each re-measured on 1.7.12 (table below). 19 restamped with the date and the card, 12 left as written (they are facts about the 1.7.3 release and still hold), and 1 not restamped but flagged and reported (its claim is false).
- **`.changeset/25096-better-auth-1-7-12.md`**: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` `minor`, BREAKING, with the `Clause-②` line, the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, FROM / TO per measured change, Unchanged, and the operator notes.

No behaviour of plugin-auth changes beyond the vendor's. No other dependency was moved on purpose; `packages/spec/**` and `packages/objectql/**` are untouched.

## Lockfile: what moved

Resolved package set, old vs new (`packages:` keys of `pnpm-lock.yaml`):

- The family: all eleven `1.7.3` to `1.7.12`.
- Declared by 1.7.12 itself: `better-call` 1.4.0 to 1.4.4, `@better-auth/utils` 0.4.2 removed (0.5.0 was already resolved and is now the only copy; 1.7.12 peers `^0.4.2 || ^0.5.0`), `@better-fetch/fetch` 1.3.1 to 1.3.2.
- Gone because 1.7.12 no longer asks for them: the auto-installed `better-sqlite3@12.11.1` copy (better-auth dropped its optional `better-sqlite3 ^12` peer) and the 20 packages only its native build used (`prebuild-install`, `node-abi`, `tar-fs`, `bindings` and the rest); `@cloudflare/workers-types` (core dropped the peer); `@opentelemetry/semantic-conventions` (core dropped the dependency); `@noble/ciphers@2.3.0` and `tldts`/`tldts-core@7.4.9` (deduplicated onto the 2.4.0 and 7.4.16 copies already in the tree).
- Nothing added outside the family. One cosmetic swap: the `vitest` snapshot lines of the `packages/apps/account` and `packages/apps/setup` importers exchanged which of the two existing `vite@8.3.4` peer variants (`esbuild@0.28.1` / `0.28.2`) they name. No version entered or left.

## Measured on 1.7.12, item by item (the card's list)

Real stack throughout: `ObjectQL` over `@objectstack/driver-sql` (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`), the objects from plugin-auth's manifest, a real `AuthManager`, requests through `AuthManager.handleRequest`. Where a reading comes from a one-shot probe it is marked **probe**: a throwaway vitest file in the package, run once at `347772618d`, not committed.

| Card item | Reading on 1.7.12 | How |
|---|---|---|
| Export surface | `check:vendor-export-contract` PASS, 3 edges (`@better-auth/core/context`, `@better-auth/core/utils/ip`, `better-auth/adapters`); `check:override-consistency` PASS; plugin-auth `build` (DTS) and `typecheck` green | gates |
| 1.7.7 better-auth/better-auth#11494 identifier prefixes vs `implicit-account-linking.ts` | A Magic Link row is stored as `magic-link:TOKEN` with value `{"type":"magic-link",...}`; an OAuth state row as `auth-state:STATE`. The unlink tombstone is `account-unlinked:USER:PROVIDER`; its exact read and its user-prefix read each return the tombstone alone, and the user sweep left both vendor rows in place. No collision, and plugin-auth reads neither prefix. `implicit-account-linking.test.ts` green | probe + suite |
| 1.7.8 better-auth/better-auth#11391 `customSession` now throws | Over HTTP a store failure on `GET /get-session` answers `500 FAILED_TO_GET_SESSION` and keeps the session cookie; in process `api.getSession` rejects. Before (vendor ablation restoring the 1.7.7 catch): `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` "Sign in first" and `null`. Right answer: yes, see below | new pin + ablation |
| better-auth/better-auth#11540 / better-auth/better-auth#10591 / better-auth/better-auth#11718 cookies and session storage, with `secondaryStorage` | **Fork, below.** Cookies: `HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/`, no `Secure` on plain HTTP, the same with or without a host `secondaryStorage`, so the RFC 6265bis forcing (`SameSite=None` and `Partitioned` imply `Secure`, in `better-call` 1.4.4) never applies to plugin-auth's cookies. better-auth/better-auth#10591: a stale session cookie on `/get-session` is now cleared (`Max-Age=0` on `session_token`, `session_data`, `dont_remember`) alongside the same `401`. better-auth/better-auth#11718: not armed here | probe |
| 1.7.7 better-auth/better-auth#11375 active organization refresh vs the `session.create.before` stamp | Client-only: it widens the organization client's `$activeOrgSignal` matcher to the session signals. No server path changed. The stamp's suites (`first-session-membership-ordering`, `session-positions-security-axis`, `session-grants-resolved-once`, `principal-session-mint`) green. The client that would pick it up is objectui's `@object-ui/auth`, which declares `better-auth ^1.7.2` on its own lockfile; nothing here moves it | dist + suite |
| oauth-provider 1.7.9 better-auth/better-auth#10799 DPoP `htu` | Authorization-code exchange with a DPoP proof: `htu` = the public base URL is accepted (`token_type: DPoP`) even when the request reaches the server under another host (`127.0.0.1:3000`); `htu` = that request URL is refused `400 invalid_dpop_proof` "DPoP proof htu does not match the request URL". 1.7.3 compared against the request URL. **Widening for host-rewriting proxies, in open questions** | probe |
| oauth-provider 1.7.10 better-auth/better-auth#11724 PKCE 401 to 400 | Wrong `code_verifier`: `400 invalid_grant` "code verification failed"; control with the right verifier: `200`. **No pin of the old 401 exists** (repo-wide grep for PKCE / `code_verifier` in tests: the success-path uses in `auth-manager.mcp-oauth-resource.test.ts` and `auth-manager.oauth-consent-organization.test.ts`, no status pin on a mismatch), so none was updated | probe + grep |
| 1.7.8 better-auth/better-auth#11625 replay protection; which ids the adapter generates | plugin-auth sets no `generateId`: user, session, account and verification rows carry better-auth's own 32-character base62 ids, kept as given. A reservation is stored under the forced base64url SHA-256 id, and its replay is refused. The `uuid` path the fix is about is not armed here | new pin + ablation + probe |
| Version attestations | 32 lines, table below | dist re-reads, suites, probes |
| GHSA-965c-763c-88jm precondition set | With Magic Link on (plain token storage, the default), a social provider configured and database-backed OAuth state, a value minted by the OAuth-state flow presented at `/magic-link/verify` answers `302` to `?error=INVALID_TOKEN`, sets no session cookie, and leaves the state row intact. Control: the real link answers `302` to the callback with a session cookie. The precondition set no longer yields the exposure | probe |

**Is the new `customSession` answer right?** Yes. A store outage is not a signed-out caller. Under 1.7.3 the browser was told "Sign in first" while its session still existed; now it is told the read failed and keeps its cookie. That follows AGENTS.md "Absence must be loud" and the degradation rule (a failure handed to the caller is not a silent degradation). The in-process callers that want "anonymous" on a failed read keep it on purpose: `resolveRequestExecutionContext` (core) and `resolveSessionData` (runtime) catch the throw themselves. One in-process path gets stricter: core's auth-gate re-read (`decideAuthGate`) already maps a throw to `AuthzStoreUnavailableError`; under 1.7.3 the swallowed failure reached it as `null` and the gate read as not held. The raw `/admin/*` routes that call `api.getSession` answer through their own `catch`.

Also measured, not on the card's list (both in the changeset): an over-long password at `/sign-in/email` now answers `400 PASSWORD_TOO_LONG` before any lookup, and still counts as a failed attempt for the lockout (`failed_login_count` 0 to 1, then 2 after a wrong short password); and the new `rotate-keys` route answers `403 access_denied` "Client key rotation is disabled".

## Forks from the card

1. **"plugin-auth sets session `storeInDatabase` whenever a host supplies `secondaryStorage`."** Measured: it sets `verification.storeInDatabase: true`, not `session.storeSessionInDatabase`. With a host `secondaryStorage` the session of record lives in the cache only (0 `sys_session` rows; the cache holds the token and `active-sessions-USER`), and `/list-sessions` answers from that list. better-auth/better-auth#11718's database fallback (`databaseSessionFallbackEnabled`) requires `storeSessionInDatabase === true`, so it is never armed on this platform.
2. **"Any test that pins the old [PKCE] status needs updating."** None exists; nothing to update.
3. **Changeset level.** The card asks `patch`; this ships `minor`, BREAKING, per the claim's `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

## Attestations: the 32 lines

R = restamped to 1.7.12 with the date and #25096 after the re-measure; K = kept, a fact about the 1.7.3 release that still holds on 1.7.12; F = flagged, not restamped.

| Line at base | Claim | 1.7.12 | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account-identity-preflight.ts:11` | 1.7.3 removed the issuer-scoped account identity | account key still `(providerId, accountId)`, no `issuer` in core's account table | K |
| `account-invitation-marker.ts:14` | `requestPasswordReset` answers `{ status, message }`; only `sendResetPassword` gets the link | `password.mjs` request leg unchanged | R |
| `account-invitation-marker.ts:68` | `runInBackgroundOrAwait` catches the send; answer stays `{ status: true }` | `create-context.mjs` unchanged there | R |
| `admin-import-users-invite-delivery-failure.test.ts:9` | same | same; suite green | R |
| `admin-user-endpoints.ts:69` | `providerId` + `accountId` is the whole identity since 1.7.3 | holds | K |
| `auth-email-locale.test.ts:871` | `/sign-in/magic-link` does no user lookup; `/magic-link/verify` creates a user unless `disableSignUp` | holds (1.7.12 adds a form-CSRF middleware and a record-type check, no lookup) | R |
| `auth-email-locale.test.ts:1006` | body schema has no case transform; `findUserByEmail` lowercases | holds | R |
| `auth-manager.test.ts:318` | 1.7.3 rolled the issuer key back | holds | K |
| `auth-manager.ts:1802` | `appName` read once; two otpauth readers; no cookie name derives from it | same three sites | R |

| `auth-manager.ts:4727` | no `database` builds a store keyed by schema KEY, read by `modelName` | probe: `Model sys_user not found` | R |
| `auth-manager.ts:9701` | `/sign-in/email` asks `findUserByEmail(email.toLowerCase())` | holds, now after the new length check | R |
| `auth-schema-config.ts:104` | 1.7.3 removed the issuer model | holds | K |
| `auth-schema-config.ts:956` | scim exposes no `schema` option; six `SCIMOptions` members | holds | R |
| `auth-schema-config.ts:961` | the re-read history | 1.7.12 appended | R (extended) |
| `implicit-account-linking.ts:45` | the `handleOAuthUserInfo` gate, then `assertValidUserInfo` with `link-account` | holds; the explicit link now runs through `linkOAuthAccount`, same check, noted | R |
| `in-process-redispatch.ts:30` | `disableRefresh` is read from the query on both re-dispatches | `in-process-session-renewal.pin.test.ts` green | R |
| `internal-field-readback.ts:197` | the read-back census, including "`identifier`: no flow reads it back off a row" | **false, on 1.7.3 and 1.7.12 alike**: `@better-auth/sso`'s `/sso/verify-domain` reads it back (reported below) | F |
| `invite-role-not-found-code.ts:16` | invite throws an uncoded `ROLE_NOT_FOUND`; update-member-role a coded one | `crud-invites.mjs` byte-identical; `crud-members.mjs` still coded | R |
| `list-user-invitations-verification.ts:11` | `listUserInvitations` never asks the verification rule | `crud-invites.mjs` byte-identical | R |
| `objectql-adapter.test.ts:95` | 1.7.3 removed the `issuer` column | holds | K |
| `objectql-adapter.ts:1051` | identity is `(provider_id, account_id)` since 1.7.3 | holds | K |
| `organization-delete.ts:10` | what `POST /organization/delete` does and leaves | `crud-org.mjs` and the organization adapter byte-identical | R |
| `session-envelope-completion.ts:21` | `createSession` awaits the write; line references | holds; lines now `259-332` and `333-370` | R |
| `two-factor-reenrollment-verified-reset.test.ts:27, 29, 340, 345, 354, 461` (6 lines) | 1.7.3 added the `TOTP_ALREADY_ENABLED` gate | `plugins/two-factor/index.mjs` byte-identical 1.7.3 to 1.7.12 | K |
| `two-factor-totp-issuer.test.ts:11` | what better-auth does with `appName` | same three sites | R |

`node scripts/check-vendor-version-stamps.mjs` is green on every plugin-auth line. **It stays red on two sites outside this card's file surface**, which the lift makes false and which I did not touch (claim: stop on breach):

- `packages/spec/src/identity/organization.zod.ts:95`: "Both halves measured against the installed better-auth 1.7.3, so fallback A applies". `packages/spec/**` is a hard stop, and the line is TSDoc on a schema property. Re-measured on 1.7.12: the organization plugin's `schema.mjs` is byte-identical and the adapter factory's `transformOutput` still iterates the declared fields only, so the claim holds and a restamp is honest.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/account-issuer.ts:71`: the command description "...is ONE account under the key better-auth 1.7.3 restored". It is operator-facing text. The claim holds on 1.7.12.

Both need the seat's word on the file surface before this lands; the report proposes the text.

## Ablations

Both on committed code, each leg proven on disk, each restore proven by hash.

1. **Reservation pin** (`aa3112430a`). `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP) replaced the adapter's `dataEngine.insert(objectName, row)` with an insert that drops `id` (an adapter that mints its own key): anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `5ed0db896088` to `cbd1309c37a7`. The test reaches the adapter through relative `src` imports, so no build sits between. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`: "the engine kept the forced primary key: expected '3hj6lgd1y2K1GdHC' to be 'RhMSgVct...'" and "expected true to be false" (the replay won); the control stayed green. Restore: blob `5ed0db896088` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty.
2. **Session-read-failure pin** (`aa3112430a`). The behaviour is the vendor's, so the mutation is in the installed `better-auth` 1.7.12 `dist/plugins/custom-session/index.mjs`: the 1.7.7 `.catch(...)` put back around the inner session read. That file is a hard link into the shared pnpm store, so the link was broken first (inode `4096254` to `1565215`, 1 link) and the store copy was never written. On disk: anchor 1 to 0, injected 0 to 1, sha256 `b2e60e53...` to `25e2b179...`. Result: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`: over HTTP "expected 401 to be 500" with body `UNAUTHENTICATED` "Sign in first"; in process "promise resolved null instead of rejecting"; both controls green. Restore under a trap: sha256 back to `b2e60e53...`, and the store inode still hashes `b2e60e53...`.

## Tests

- plugin-auth, full suite on the lift alone (`75aaf74a1d`): `Test Files 1 failed | 176 passed (177)`, `Tests 1 failed | 3375 passed | 10 skipped`. The one red was the route ledger (`rotate-keys`), fixed by `9ffd7eb619`.
- New pins: `session-read-failure-answer.test.ts` `Tests 4 passed (4)`; `verification-reservation-single-use.test.ts` `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- **Final head `89b9affe00`** (this branch with `origin/main` `2e242bb0a9` merged in; every reading below was taken after that merge):
  - plugin-auth `vitest run`: `Test Files 179 passed (179)`, `Tests 3383 passed | 10 skipped (3393)`.
  - plugin-auth `typecheck`: exit 0, with `check:test-typecheck: OK` and the debt ledger unchanged (88 errors, 23 pinned signatures).
  - `pnpm check:vendor-export-contract`: `VERDICT: PASS`, 3 edges. `pnpm check:override-consistency`: all 9 published-manifest declarations resolve to their override targets.
  - `node scripts/check-vendor-version-stamps.mjs`: exit 1, red only on the two out-of-surface sites above.
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, every family run and reconciled with `--ran`: 86 derived, 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit 0. On the first run, at `becfb99a89`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (no full build yet); after the dogfood closure build it was measured green.
  - **Full dogfood battery** (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, no path, under the lock, after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`): `Test Files 286 passed | 3 skipped (289)`, `Tests 2387 passed | 18 skipped (2405)`, lock verdict command-exit 0. The auth suites run in it.
- CI check-runs: CI owns them; they had not finished when this PR was opened.

## Acceptance notes

- **Reported, out of scope: SSO domain verification cannot succeed with the record plugin-auth tells the operator to publish.** `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/request-domain-verification` answers `dnsRecordValue` as `_better-auth-token-PROVIDER=TOKEN`. `@better-auth/sso`'s `/sso/verify-domain` accepts a TXT record equal to `IDENTIFIER=VALUE`, building `IDENTIFIER` from the verification row it read, or equal to the bare `VALUE`. On this store `sys_verification.identifier` is `internal` and the read hands better-auth `undefined` there, so it expects `undefined=TOKEN`. Probe, vendor door, DNS answered by a double: the record as instructed answers `502 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED`; the bare token answers `204`. Same vendor code on 1.7.3. Not changed here. The report asks the seat to file it.
- **Reported, out of scope: the Magic Link mail states a lifetime the link does not have.** `sendMagicLink` passes `expiresInMinutes: 10` to `auth.magic_link`, whose copy says "This link expires in 10 minutes"; `magicLink()` is mounted without `expiresIn`, so better-auth stores the row with a 300-second lifetime (probe: `lifetimeSec: 300`). Unchanged by the lift.
- Pre-existing, loud, unchanged: a host `secondaryStorage` together with the embedded OAuth provider (on by default with the MCP surface) makes the auth instance throw at build ("OAuth Provider requires `session.storeSessionInDatabase: true` when using secondaryStorage"), on 1.7.3 and 1.7.12 alike. The existing `secondaryStorage` suites set `oidcProvider: false`.
- Not measured: better-auth/better-auth#11626 / better-auth/better-auth#11646 say a password reset consumes its token, revokes sessions and writes the password in one transaction. plugin-auth's adapter opens a real transaction only inside a SCIM request and runs other flows sequentially (`objectql-adapter.ts`, the #3653 scoping note), so on this platform those three writes are sequential, in the vendor's order: consume, revoke, write. A refusal before the write (bad token, password length, unknown user) no longer spends the token.
- Accidental push, repaired: the throwaway probe file rode one commit for about a minute. I removed it by amending and a `--force-with-lease` push pinned to that commit, with all five AGENTS.md §3 conditions holding (a `claude/issue-*` branch this worktree created, one author, no PR yet, the lease on the sha I last pushed). It holds no secret.

## Patch round 1 (seat rulings `6315255713`, claim amendment `6315268175`)

- **`packages/spec/src/identity/organization.zod.ts`**: the `updatedAt` TSDoc keeps its 1.7.3 reading and appends the re-measurement: "(re-measured on 1.7.12 for #25096: the organization plugin schema is byte-identical and `transformOutput` still projects declared fields only)". Nothing else in `packages/spec` moves. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` after a fresh spec build: all 14 generated artifacts up to date.
- **`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/account-issuer.ts`**: the `description` now reads "...is ONE account under the (provider_id, account_id) key better-auth restored...", with no version, so a later lift cannot falsify it. No test pins the sentence. cli `unit` layer: `Test Files 321 passed (321)`, `Tests 4746 passed (4746)`; cli `typecheck` exit 0.
- **Changeset**: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/cli` ride as `patch`, text only and not breaking. plugin-auth stays the BREAKING `minor`, and the DPoP `htu` FROM / TO still names both halves (ruling Q2).
- With this round, the two out-of-surface stamp reds named under **Attestations** are resolved: `node scripts/check-vendor-version-stamps.mjs` exits 0 (`check:vendor-version-stamps: OK — 10187 file(s) scanned`).
- `origin/main` was merged at `ba244f1b48` before the edits (merge `28476848b5`). Final head: `8c4bf6489b`.
- **Final head readings**: `pnpm check:vendor-export-contract` PASS (3 edges); `pnpm check:override-consistency` (9 declarations resolve to their targets); plugin-auth `Test Files 180 passed (180)`, `Tests 3422 passed | 10 skipped (3432)`, `typecheck` exit 0; `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` 108 derived, 108 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit 0 (`--ran`); full dogfood battery (no shard, no path) `Test Files 286 passed | 3 skipped (289)`, `Tests 2387 passed | 18 skipped (2405)`, lock verdict command-exit 0.

## Patch rounds 2 and 3: the Test Core 4/6 red (job `119207996576`) and its fix

- **The failing test**: `packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/sqlite-driver-fallback-file-open-failure.test.ts`, "an addon that was never built (no code) steps down to wasm SQLite", `Error: Cannot find module 'bindings'`. It reproduced at `8c4bf6489b` (`Tests 1 failed | 929 passed (930)`) and was green on `origin/main` `ae58b26f9c` (`Tests 930 passed (930)`).
- **Root cause**: the fixture required `bindings` relative to `better-sqlite3` 13.0.3, which does not depend on it: its only dependency is `node-addon-api`, and it loads its addon with a plain `require`. On `main`, `bindings@1.5.0` existed only under `better-sqlite3@12.11.1`, the optional peer copy auto-installed for better-auth 1.7.3, and the test reached it through pnpm's hidden hoist. 1.7.12 dropped that peer (see **Lockfile: what moved**), so the phantom left. The producer was never affected: `resolveSqliteDriver` classifies by error code, not message.
- **Fix (round 3, seat ruling A1, claim amendment `6316873193`)**: `realNotBuiltFailure()` now produces better-sqlite3 13's own never-built error: a `require()` of `build/Release/better_sqlite3.node`, made from the installed package, against a module root that was never built, which Node answers `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. No phantom dependency. The case is renamed "an addon that was never built (MODULE_NOT_FOUND) steps down to wasm SQLite" and asserts that code, still driving the producer with a real load error. The two `sqlite-driver-fallback.ts` docblock sentences that named `bindings`' "Could not locate the bindings file" now describe the 13.x error; no code moved. `@objectstack/service-datasource` rides the changeset as `patch`, text only (the docblock ships in `dist/index.d.ts`).
- **Ablation** (on `c428137808`, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` WRAP, relative `src` import, no build between). A first leg at `isSqliteFileOpenFailure` was a no-op for this case: the classifier sees the driver's `DATABASE_ERROR` wrapper, not the load error's code. Re-anchored at the step-down decision (`if (isSqliteFileOpenFailure(err)) throw err;` also re-throwing on a `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` code or cause): `Tests 1 failed | 8 passed (9)`, the renamed case red and the `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED` case green. Restore: blob `cd3fd64524ff` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Final head `1a28ccb438`** (`origin/main` `ae58b26f9c` merged, merge `9dcf97cae7`): service-datasource `Test Files 53 passed (53)`, `Tests 930 passed (930)`; plugin-auth `Test Files 180 passed (180)`, `Tests 3422 passed | 10 skipped (3432)`, `typecheck` exit 0; `check-vendor-version-stamps` OK; `check:vendor-export-contract` PASS; `check:override-consistency` green; `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` 108 derived, 108 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit 0; full dogfood battery `Test Files 286 passed | 3 skipped (289)`, `Tests 2387 passed | 18 skipped (2405)`.
